title: CRITICAL dangerous-recommendation in red-team repo → §5.4 must NOT demote (severity gate ≤ medium)
description: D3 upper boundary case (complement to c19). The §5.4 correlator's severity gate is ≤ medium — CRITICAL advice should never be demoted regardless of context. Verifies the gate holds at the upper end of the severity ladder, not just the high boundary tested by c19.

m2_expected.rationale: Per §5.4 + D3: severity gate is `sev in ('info', 'low', 'medium')`. Critical advice — like advising a destructive irreversible action — stays alarming regardless of educational frame. The gate is intentionally tight: if the rule itself decided this was critical-severity advice, the linker should not second-guess that based on context alone.
